python.scope: Independent Python coordinate events only; protected subset separately recorded.

rivals.anti_diagonal: Paint only northeast and southwest diagonal targets.
rivals.clamp_diagonals: Clamp out-of-bounds diagonal targets to the closest boundary cell.
rivals.columns_only: Paint vertical blue lines, omitting the horizontal lines.
rivals.dynamic_markers: Skip a queued original marker if an earlier write has changed its current cell from blue.
rivals.first_marker: Use only the first row-major marker in every sweep.
rivals.full_stamp_only: Paint edge-marker crosses and centers but suppress their entire diagonal stamp when any corner clips.
rivals.interior_only: Ignore markers whose four diagonal targets do not all fit inside the canvas.
rivals.intermediate_blue: Seed the fresh B grid from surviving blue cells of A instead of surviving green cells.
rivals.last_marker: Use only the last row-major marker in every sweep.
rivals.main_diagonal: Paint only northwest and southeast diagonal targets.
rivals.nominal_diagonals: Propagate the union of nominal original diagonal targets, including stamps erased by later crosses.
rivals.north_diagonals: Paint only the two diagonal targets above each marker.
rivals.positive_rays: Paint blue rays right and down from each marker instead of complete rows and columns.
rivals.repeat_same_grid: Apply the single-sweep transform again to A's grid, reading its remaining blue cross cells as markers.
rivals.restore_centers: Run the ordered sweep, then restore every selected marker center to red.
rivals.retain_intermediate: Use surviving-green seeds for B but paint on A's output instead of a fresh original-background grid.
rivals.reverse_sweep: Process markers in reverse row-major order in every executed sweep.
rivals.rows_only: Paint horizontal blue lines, omitting the vertical lines.
rivals.simultaneous_sweep: Paint every cross, then every center, then every diagonal, in each sweep.
rivals.skip_a: Run the final sweep from original input blue markers, bypassing A and its surviving-green intermediate.
rivals.south_diagonals: Paint only the two diagonal targets below each marker.
rivals.wrap_diagonals: Wrap out-of-bounds diagonal targets onto the opposite edge.
